snippet.title: Ship v Maze introduction
snippet.description:
I'm happy to announce my first game, Ship v Maze. 

Fly through an endless sequence of mazes and try not to hit the walls. Then try to do better.

This will be available on Steam (https://store.steampowered.com/app/4113380) and maybe other platforms.
